LESSON: MONEY

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: MEASUREMENT
Topic 2.7: Money
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Money, part of MEASUREMENT in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade five MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: when saving money and share with others. 1. How do you manage your money? 2. How can you save money?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Money together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Unity: A learner cooperates and respects other learners’ opinions when conducting group discussions on various matters

such as budgeting, taxes, savings among others.

● Responsibility: A learner enhances their accountability skills when discussing factors to consider in order to save wisely.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Safety and security: A learner observes internet safety and security as they use safe and secure online sites to learn more on

taxes, budgeting and bank services.

● Socio-economic Issues: A learner enhances their financial literacy skills when carrying out discussions on budgeting,

savings, taxes and banking.
